snippet.title: Organize my Shop — Official Game Trailer (Cozy Organization Puzzle)
snippet.description:
Official trailer for "Organize my Shop" — the ultimate cozy, anti-stress organization puzzle game where sorting groceries becomes a satisfying form of art! ✨🛒

Do you know that wonderful feeling when chaos turns into perfect harmony? Leave the rush behind and tame the messy conveyor belt! Stack and arrange delicious cheeses, pastries, sweets, and savory items neatly onto the shelves and into huge refrigerators. With randomized item spawns, zero penalties, and total freedom to move things around, you can create your flawless layout over and over again.

🌍 Play Worldwide: The game is fully accessible for players from all countries, as it features text only in the main menu!

🎮 Play the Free Demo & Add to wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4751340/Organize_my_Shop/
🚀 Coming July 24, 2026!
🌟 Explore our full collection: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45978844

Game Features:
📦 Tame the Chaos: Scroll through the conveyor belt and find the perfect spot for every single item;
🧊 Multi-Shelf Exploration: Seamlessly switch between different display racks and massive refrigerators;
🧺 Stack Mechanics: Pile items neatly into 2 or 3 layers on the shelves or combine them right on the belt;
🎨 Endless Replayability: Randomly generated item order makes every level a fresh, meditative experience;
💖 Pure Perfectionist Bliss: Charming hand-drawn art, soft colors, satisfying ASMR audio, and NO timers or stress!

Subscribe for more updates, trailers, and upcoming cozy releases!
📬 Contact us: owlshowls.steam@gmail.com
